capabilities: diagnostic analysis of the engine's findings
review of the columns of an uploaded file
plain-language rewording of the engine's explanation
fallback: When no model is configured, cannot be reached or gives an answer that fails a check, the deterministic engine's own text is shown instead, and the page says so.
role: A language model interprets and explains what the engine found. It never decides, never supplies a figure and never acts: the deterministic engine is the only authority for a recommendation.
